title: A service call, start to finish
blurb: The phone rings and something is broken. Everything between that and getting paid.
asks: Walk me through what happens from the phone ringing to the invoice going out.
sample:
From: Dana Whitfield <dwhitfield@northsidedental.example>

Hi — this is Dana at Northside Dental. Our upstairs unit is blowing warm air again, same as March. Model RTU-4400-B. We have patients Monday so we need somebody out Friday if you can. 229-555-0142. We're at 1180 Millbrook Road, Suite 4. PO 88213 if you need one.

Thanks,
Dana

steps.name: Take the call and write it down
steps.note: Usually written on a pad first because the caller is still talking.

steps.name: Find out if we've been there before
steps.note: Last visit, what was fixed, what it cost.

steps.name: Get it on the board
steps.note: Who is closest, who has the part, who the customer likes.

steps.name: Tech writes up what they did
steps.note: In the truck, at the end of the call.

steps.name: Type the ticket into the system
Chase the ones that don't pay
